summary: Wave Life Sciences Ltd. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, announcing a hearing regarding its proposed redomiciliation from Singapore to the United States. The redomiciliation will involve a proxy solicitation; no financial terms, premium, or advisor are disclosed. The company expects to file a definitive proxy statement with the SEC. This event is a corporate restructuring via reincorporation rather than a merger, tender offer, or capital return. Watch for shareholder vote timing and any regulatory hurdles that may affect the closing date.
